verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox or test environment isolated from production data. Uplink lets a developer test an unpublished MCP server against a real agent, which is pre-publish testing rather than isolation. Token scoping and namespaces are access-control features, not a sandbox. The shutdown notice also states there is no longer a documented API surface to sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
